{{Quote|There goes another one. I think it's the ''Laudable''.''"<br />"''Hmrm.''"<br />"''That's General Ares' ship, isn't it?''"<br />"''Hmrm.|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] [[Rys/Legends|Rys]] and [[Jek/Legends|Jek]]|<ref name="TCW:P">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Laudable''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the ''Laudable'' was dispatched from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under the command of the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]], to patrol the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity. While on patrol, the ''Laudable''{{'s}} task force&mdash;consisting of at least two other [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]&mdash;was [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] equipped with two [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] on each of its sides. Under the command of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the ''Malevolence'' took down the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the entire Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] with its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. After doing so, the ''Malevolence'' proceeded to destroy Nune's task force, including the ''Laudable'', using its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to obliterate the exposed [[Starship/Legends|ships]].

==Description==
The ''Laudable'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="TCW:S" /> manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] that served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It was armed with fifty-two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]], two medium dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, four [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]] tubes, and six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors. The ''Laudable'' was 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long,<ref name="Databank" /> and was equipped with [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and two [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]].<ref name="TCW:S" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> while docked at the [[Drydock/Legends|drydocks]] of the Republic's [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the ''Laudable'' was assigned to the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]].<ref name="TCW:P" /> [[General/Legends|General]] Nune was in command of a Republic task force, made up of at least two other ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], to patrol the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] for Separatist activity. Nune himself used the ''Laudable'' as his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] while in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TCW:S" /> The ''Laudable''{{'s}} departure from Coruscant was witnessed by the [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] [[Rys/Legends|Rys]] and [[Jek/Legends|Jek]], who were near the drydocks, waiting for their next assignment.<ref name="TCW:P" />

[[File:Kite_Nune_talking.png|thumb|left|275px|Kite and Nune talking on the bridge of the ''Laudable'']]
While on patrol, the ''Laudable''{{'s}} task force's initial sweeps reported no enemy activity. Nune, from the bridge of the ''Laudable'', ordered another scan of the surrounding area to be sure nothing had been missed. While the secondary sweeps were underway, [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]], a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] stationed aboard the ''Laudable'', began to discuss the mission with Nune on the bridge.<ref name="TCW:S" />

However, a new Confederate weapon was hiding out of sight of the Republic task force in the form of the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] under the command of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. As Kite and Nune were finishing up their conversation on the bridge, Grievous ordered the ''Malevolence'' to [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|fire]] its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] at the Republic task force, which disabled the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the entire Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The ''Malevolence'' destroyed the ''Laudable'', along with the rest of the Republic fleet, killing Kite, Nune, and everyone else onboard.<ref name="TCW:S" />

The loss of the ''Laudable'' and the rest of Nune's battle group was later reported in a press release by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. An audio recording of a clone trooper stationed on the ''Laudable'' during the attack survived the battle, and the transmission was played during the broadcast. Despite the quick destruction of the ''Laudable'', the recording stated that an evacuation of the ''Laudable'' via its [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] had been attempted, but the crew was not quick enough.<ref name="HoloNet News" />

==Commanders and crew==
The last commander of the ''Laudable'' was General Ares Nune, who was in charge of the Star Destroyer at Phu. The ''Laudable''{{'s}} crew included [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Kite and numerous [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="TCW:S" /> The entire crew of the ''Laudable'', including Kite and Nune, was killed by the ''Malevolence'' in the Phu system.<ref name="HoloNet News" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Laudable'' made a brief cameo in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Prelude|''Prelude'']], which led into "[[Ambush]],"<ref name="TCW:S" /> the first episode in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars television series'']].<ref name="Ambush Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}}</ref> The ''Laudable'' was given a more significant role in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shakedown|''Shakedown'']], which led into "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']],"<ref name="TCW:S" /> the second episode in ''The Clone Wars'' television series.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The loss of General Nune's task force was reported in the [[in-universe]] ''[[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided]]'', the first installment of the online [[HoloNet News (podcast)|Holonet News podcast]] series that took place before the events of "Rising ''Malevolence''."<ref name="All Hear This">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>
